description: get_setting() in config.py is supposed to look up keys case-insensitively and ignoring surrounding whitespace, but case-insensitive lookups return nothing. The lookup relies on a normalization helper; the fix belongs in that helper, not in config.py, and must keep the existing whitespace handling.
source_pattern: Cross-file bug: case-insensitive config lookup fails because the shared normalize_key helper does not lowercase.
